integrity: Proof uses rowwise convex extreme-point reduction and an exact finite rooted-tree capacity argument; supplementary finite checks do not replace the proof.
scientific_limitations: Exact-arithmetic worst-case finite-sweep Euclidean inner residual for unit lower-triangular factors with explicit row-absolute-sum and maximum-column-nonzero bounds; not a claim about typical ILU factors, outer Krylov convergence, or finite precision.
title: Sharp sparse-branching transient law for diagonally dominant triangular Jacobi solves
